summary: The original E-RUNTIME cancellation and effect-policy work is supported by focused shared-host and lifecycle tests, but the wrapper closes its effect driver before knowing whether host unmount succeeded. A reentrant unmount during completion validation returns false while leaving the runtime mounted; subsequent Go effects then fail because the driver is closed. The independent review preserved a compiled-fixture reproduction and excludes the separate R-EFFECT-SLICE gate.

finding.observed: The first request succeeds. A completion ownKeys trap calls wrapper unmount and receives false. The completion is fenced after cancellation, runtime.isUnmounted remains false, and a later child request fails with lifecycle effect driver is closed.
